definition: The group of words for how a figure on a drawn plate relates to the record it came from.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`figure` holds how a figure on a drawn plate relates to the record it came from", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
